mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/72d114346041-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/72d114346041-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_1D2D 모델링 준비: tp 단위 코호트/특성/결과 테이블과 분할 배정 생성 (학습·성능 계산 없음)."""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"; OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.load(open(WS / "design_1D2D.json"))
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

# tp 생성: 입원 기준 offset, 단 tp 시점에 재원 중(tp < discharge)인 경우만
tp = a.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tp["tp"] = tp.admit_time + tp.offset_h * H
n_all = len(tp)
tp = tp[tp.tp < tp.discharge_time].reset_index(drop=True)
tp["window_censored"] = tp.discharge_time < tp.tp + 48 * H  # 결과 창이 퇴원으로 잘림
tp = tp.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")

cr = l[l.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

def kdigo_events(times, vals):
    """각 측정이 KDIGO(48h +0.3 또는 7일 최솟값 1.5배)를 만족하는지 (이전 측정 기준)."""
    flag = np.zeros(len(vals), bool)
    for i in range(len(vals)):
        prev = (times < times[i]) & (times >= times[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))
        if prev.any():
            p48 = prev & (times >= times[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))
            if p48.any() and vals[i] - vals[p48].min() >= 0.3: flag[i] = True
            if vals[i] >= 1.5 * vals[prev].min(): flag[i] = True
    return flag

rows = []
for r in tp.itertuples():
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    rec = {"admission_id": r.admission_id, "offset_h": r.offset_h}
    if g is None:
        rec.update(aki_known_by_tp=False, aki_48h=0, n_cr_window=0); rows.append(rec); continue
    # exclusion: tp까지 보고된(report_time<=tp) 크레아티닌만으로 KDIGO 판정
    k = g[g.report_time <= r.tp]
    rec["aki_known_by_tp"] = bool(kdigo_events(k.collect_time.values, k.value.values).any()) if len(k) else False
    # outcome: collect_time 기준, 기준창 tp-168h ~ 결과창 tp+48h (index admission 내)
    o = g[(g.collect_time >= r.tp - 168 * H) & (g.collect_time < r.tp + 48 * H)]
    f = kdigo_events(o.collect_time.values, o.value.values)
    in_win = (o.collect_time >= r.tp).values
    rec["aki_48h"] = int((f & in_win).any())
    rec["n_cr_window"] = int(in_win.sum())
    rows.append(rec)
tp = tp.merge(pd.DataFrame(rows), on=["admission_id", "offset_h"])

# inclusion
n_cr_total = cr.groupby("admission_id").size()  # 설계: admit~discharge 전체 (미래 정보 포함 — 보고서 참조)
tp["cr_count_admission"] = tp.admission_id.map(n_cr_total).fillna(0)
tp["incl_adult"] = tp.age >= 18
tp["incl_cr_monitored"] = tp.cr_count_admission >= 3

# features (report_time <= tp)
def lab_feat(test, start, agg):
    s = l[l.test == test].merge(tp[["admission_id", "offset_h", "tp", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
    lo = s.admit_time if start == "admit" else s.tp - 48 * H
    s = s[(s.report_time >= lo) & (s.report_time <= s.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    gb = s.groupby(["admission_id", "offset_h"]).value
    return {"count": gb.size, "max": gb.max, "min": gb.min, "last": gb.last}[agg]()

feat = tp[["admission_id", "offset_h"]].set_index(["admission_id", "offset_h"])
for f in design["features"]:
    if f["source"] == "labs":
        v = lab_feat(f["filter"]["test"][0], f["window"]["start"], f["agg"])
        feat[f["name"]] = v.reindex(feat.index)
        if f["agg"] == "count": feat[f["name"]] = feat[f["name"]].fillna(0)
feat = feat.reset_index()
tp = tp.merge(feat, on=["admission_id", "offset_h"])

# split: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측은 patient_id로 대체(설계 미정의 — 보고서 참조)
sp = design["split"]
tp["split_group"] = tp.family_id.fillna(tp.patient_id)
groups = np.array(sorted(tp.split_group.unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
test_g = set(rng.choice(groups, int(round(len(groups) * sp["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
tp["split"] = np.where(tp.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")

keep = tp.incl_adult & tp.incl_cr_monitored & ~tp.aki_known_by_tp
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp",
        "window_censored", "n_cr_window", "discharge_status"] + [f["name"] for f in design["features"]] + ["aki_48h"]
tp.loc[keep, cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv.gz", index=False)

# 요약
c = tp[keep]
summ = {
    "tp_candidates": n_all, "tp_in_hospital": len(tp),
    "excluded_not_adult": int((~tp.incl_adult).sum()),
    "excluded_cr_monitored_lt3": int((~tp.incl_cr_monitored).sum()),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp": int((tp.incl_adult & tp.incl_cr_monitored & tp.aki_known_by_tp).sum()),
    "final_tp": int(len(c)), "final_admissions": int(c.admission_id.nunique()), "final_patients": int(c.patient_id.nunique()),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(p.family_id.isna().sum()), "n_patients": len(p),
    "split_counts": c.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits_if_family_only": None,
    "window_censored_tp": int(c.window_censored.sum()),
    "feature_missing_rate": c[[f["name"] for f in design["features"]]].isna().mean().round(3).to_dict(),
    "by_unit": c.groupby("unit").agg(n_tp=("aki_48h", "size"), mean_cr_in_window=("n_cr_window", "mean")).round(2).to_dict(),
    "tp_with_lt3_cr_at_tp_but_included": int((c.n_cr < 3).sum()),
}
json.dump(summ, open(OUT / "summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str)
print(json.dumps(summ, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str))
EOF
